title.zh: Drift Foundation上线DFX索赔与赎回，每损失1 USDT可领1 DFX
title.en: Drift Foundation上线DFX索赔与赎回，每损失1 USDT可领1 DFX

current_state.zh: Drift Foundation launched DFX claims and redemption for verified victims of the April 1 exploit (~$295.4M stolen), granting 1 DFX per 1 USDT of loss redeemable against a Recovery Pool of ~3.11M USDT backed by up to $127.5M in Tether matching funds and up to $20M from strategic partners, with claims closing 2028-01-01 UTC.
